info.title: Chat Presence API
info.description:
Provides methods for retrieving the presence status of agents and users
within the chat platform. Supports querying presence by profile IDs for both
chat agents and App Messaging users.

region.description: The Dotdigital region id your account belongs to

get.summary: Retrieves the presence for a list of agent's profileIds

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of a profile to retrieve presence settings for

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The current status of the profile

200.description: The presence for each profile requested

get.summary: Retrieves the presence for a list of user's profileIds

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of a profile to retrieve presence settings for

200.description: The presence for each profile requested

status.description: The current status of the profile

isAway.description: Set to true when the user is 'Away'

isConnected.description: Set to true when the user is logged in and connected

lastUpdatedOn.description: The time the profiles presence was last updated

status.description: The current status of the profile

lastUpdatedOn.description: The time the profiles presence was last updated

createdOn.description: The time the profiles presence was created
